Then gather case IDs from both results, combine them, then call briefs_display_cases with combined case IDs. The user wants top 5 relevant cases. We could combine results and then pick top 5. But we don't have ranking. We can just combine and then pass all case IDs to briefs_display_cases. But the user specifically wants top 5 relevant cases. We could combine results and then pass all case IDs, but the briefs_display_cases will display briefs for all. But we can limit to 5 by selecting first 5 from combined list. Let's do that.

We'll call court_records_search_cases for New York with query 'Theft', year 2021, limit 5. Then same for San Francisco. Then combine case IDs. Then take first 5. Then call briefs_display_cases.
